# Pinned Netherite Tier sources

These JSON/Java files are unchanged from Tinkers' Construct revision
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`:

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/tree/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2

Source paths and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in the manifest. The native goal
adapts only the icon item key. The predicate reads the port's effective-tier
snapshot, not an inferred raw material or mere possession of a Netherite ingot.
